readme:
# Kuaishou App Selection Feed API

Retrieves the recommended selection feed items directly from the Kuaishou app home page without requiring any input parameters.

## Use cases

- Monitor trending and recommended video content on the Kuaishou platform.
- Gather home page selection feed data for audience interest research.
- Track popular media items displayed to general Kuaishou app users.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/kuaishou/app/selection-feed" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

## Notes

- The feed does not use cursor pagination; call the endpoint again to retrieve additional content.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [Kuaishou Brand Top List](/apis/kuaishou/app/brand-top-list): Returns top brand rankings and related live stream links from Kuaishou.
- [Kuaishou App Share Link](/apis/kuaishou/app/generate-share-link): Generates a shareable URL for Kuaishou application content using a specified object identifier.
- [Kuaishou Hot Board Categories](/apis/kuaishou/app/hot-board-categories): Returns the active list of hot board categories available in the Kuaishou app.
